verdict.rationale: TeamViewer is a remote-desktop and screen-sharing product, so using a tablet or spare device as an extended display is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions extending the desktop onto another device as a second display. The pack covers remote access, IT management, AR assistance and AI features only, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As a power user, a tablet or spare device works as an additional display that extends the desktop, not only a mirror of it
